# Generate a list of binary and ternary oxide compositions

# Common oxide-forming elements
elements = ['Li', 'Na', 'K', 'Mg', 'Ca', 'Sr', 'Ba', 'Al', 'Si', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn', 'Ga', 'Ge', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Sn', 'La', 'Ce', 'Pr', 'Nd', 'Sm', 'Eu', 'Gd', 'Tb', 'Dy', 'Ho', 'Er', 'Tm', 'Yb', 'Lu', 'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Pb', 'Bi']

# Generate binary oxides
binary_oxides = []
for element in elements:
    # Common oxidation states
    if element in ['Li', 'Na', 'K']:
        binary_oxides.append(f'{element}2O')
    elif element in ['Mg', 'Ca', 'Sr', 'Ba', 'Zn', 'Pb']:
        binary_oxides.append(f'{element}O')
    elif element in ['Al', 'Ga', 'Fe', 'Cr', 'Mn']:
        binary_oxides.append(f'{element}2O3')
    elif element in ['Si', 'Ge', 'Ti', 'Zr', 'Hf', 'Sn', 'Ce']:
        binary_oxides.append(f'{element}O2')
    elif element in ['V']:
        binary_oxides.append(f'{element}2O5')
    elif element in ['Mo', 'W']:
        binary_oxides.append(f'{element}O3')
    elif element in ['Co', 'Ni', 'Cu']:
        binary_oxides.append(f'{element}O')
    elif element in ['La', 'Pr', 'Nd', 'Sm', 'Eu', 'Gd', 'Tb', 'Dy', 'Ho', 'Er', 'Tm', 'Yb', 'Lu']:
        binary_oxides.append(f'{element}2O3')
    elif element in ['Nb', 'Ta']:
        binary_oxides.append(f'{element}2O5')
    elif element in ['Bi']:
        binary_oxides.append(f'{element}2O3')

# Generate a subset of ternary oxides (limiting to keep the dataset manageable)
ternary_oxides = [
    'LiCoO2',
    'LiFePO4',
    'LiMn2O4',
    'NaFeO2',
    'CaTiO3',
    'SrTiO3',
    'BaTiO3',
    'MgAl2O4',
    'ZnFe2O4',
    'CaWO4',
    'BiFeO3',
    'LaAlO3',
    'YBa2Cu3O7',
    'Y3Al5O12',  # YAG
    'LaNiO3',
    'LaCoO3',
    'LaMnO3',
    'ZnSnO3',
    'ZnTiO3',
    'NiTiO3'
]

# Combine binary and ternary oxides
all_oxides = binary_oxides + ternary_oxides

# Print the list of oxide compositions
print(f"Total number of oxide compositions: {len(all_oxides)}")
print("Binary oxides:")
print(binary_oxides)
print("\nTernary oxides:")
print(ternary_oxides)

# Return the list for further processing
all_oxides

}

# Apply corrections
corrected_compositions = [corrections.get(comp, comp) for comp in compositions]

additional_oxides = [
    'TiO2',   # Titanium dioxide
